lede: Conti Meister is a car workshop at Loyang Enterprise on Loyang Way. Its own website describes it as a continental car specialist for Mercedes-Benz and the Volkswagen group makes, with servicing, repairs, performance upgrades and bodywork.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention a quick OBD scan when an engine warning light came on, help with an accident claim, gearbox and clutch advice, and fast replies even at weekends without pushing unneeded work.
faqs: Google Maps lists it as a car repair workshop.
The hours are listed in the Google Maps section above. Please see Google Maps for current hours.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, contimeister.sg.
good_to_know: Towing is listed among its services
